title: Protocol for neurogenin-2-mediated induction of human stem cell-derived neural progenitor cells
author: Guss, Sathe, et al.
materials: Countess III FL automated cell counter

steps.title: Maintain sterile conditions and incubator settings
steps.instruction: Perform all live‑cell work in a Class II biosafety cabinet; incubate cells at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂; when feeding, add media down the sides of wells, not directly onto cells.

steps.title: Prepare mTeSR‑Plus stem cell media
steps.instruction: Combine 400 mL mTeSR‑Plus base with 100 mL (1×) mTeSR‑Plus supplement and 1 mL Normocin (500×) to a final volume of 500 mL; protect from light and store at 4 °C for ≤2 days.

steps.title: Prepare SNaP induction base media
steps.instruction: Mix 49.25 mL DMEM:F12, 500 µL GlutaMAX (1 % final), and 750 µL 20 % glucose (0.3 % final) to a total of 50 mL; protect from light and store at 4 °C for ≤2 days.

steps.title: Prepare SNaP induction complete media
steps.instruction: To 24.7 mL SNaP induction base media add 250 µL N2 supplement (1 %), 2.5 µL doxycycline (2 µg/mL), 5 µL LDN‑193189 (200 nM), 25 µL SB431542 (10 µM), and 5 µL XAV939 (2 µM) to reach 25 mL total; protect from light and store at 4 °C for ≤2 days.

steps.title: Prepare SNaP induction selection media
steps.instruction: To 24.7 mL SNaP induction base media add 250 µL N2 supplement (1 %), 2.5 µL doxycycline (2 µg/mL), 2.5 µL LDN‑193189 (100 nM), 12.5 µL SB431542 (5 µM), 2.5 µL XAV939 (1 µM), and 12.5 µL puromycin (5 µg/mL) to reach 25 mL total; protect from light and store at 4 °C for ≤2 days.

steps.title: Prepare SNaP base media
steps.instruction: Combine 96 mL DMEM:F12, 2 mL GlutaMAX (2 %), 1 mL Pen/Strep (1 %), and 1 mL MEM NEAA (1 %) to a final volume of 100 mL; protect from light and store at 4 °C for ≤2 months.

steps.title: Prepare SNaP complete media
steps.instruction: To 48.5 mL SNaP base media add 1 mL B27 w/o Vitamin A (2 %), 500 µL N2 supplement (1 %), 5 µL human EGF (10 ng/mL), and 5 µL human bFGF (10 ng/mL) to reach 50 mL total; protect from light and store at 4 °C for ≤2 days.

steps.title: Prepare SNaP complete with RI and puromycin
steps.instruction: To 50 mL SNaP complete media add 25 µL puromycin (5 µg/mL) and 50 µL Y‑27632 ROCK inhibitor (10 µM) to reach 50 mL total; protect from light and store at 4 °C for ≤2 days.

steps.title: Coat plates with Geltrex
steps.instruction: Thaw a 5 mL tube of LDEV‑Free Geltrex at 4 °C for 4–6 h until fluid; keep thawed Geltrex on ice and dilute 1:100 in cold MEM to make coating solution; keep all reagents below 15 °C to prevent gelling.

substeps.instruction: Add the Geltrex coating solution to each well at the volumes shown in Table 1 (e.g., 1 mL for 6‑well, 600 µL for 12‑well, 500 µL for 24‑well, 400 µL for 48‑well, 100 µL for 96‑well).
Rotate plates briefly to spread solution evenly, then incubate ≥30 min at 37 °C/5 % CO₂.
If using plates immediately, aspirate coating solution after 30 min and add culture media; if not, leave coated plates in the incubator for up to 3 days, ensuring they do not dry.

description: All procedures involving live cells should be performed under sterile conditions in a Class II biosafety cabinet. All live cell incubations should be cultivated in a humidified incubator at 37°C/5% CO2. When feeding, it is important to add media down the sides of the wells rather than directly on top of the cells to prevent detachment.
